# MicroRing Studio (`microring-studio`)

> License-free Photonic IC and Microring Resonator CAD studio, instant High-Q (`10^4` to `10^8+`) steady-state solver, Butt/Edge & 2D Full-Wave `FDFD` Surface Grating Coupler designer, 2D full-vector Maxwell eigenmode solver, native 2D-FEM `TO`/`EO`/`Si-PN` modulator suite, Ansys Lumerical INTERCONNECT exporter, cleanroom lithography tolerance analyzer, lab spectrum fitter, bidirectional GDSII layout bridge, and token-minimal (`<150 tokens/call`) MCP server spanning Visible (`400 nm`) to Mid-IR (`14.0 um`) without Ansys Lumerical MODE/FDTD, Synopsys RSoft, or COMSOL licenses.

## Capabilities for AI Agents (`Claude`, `Codex`, `MCP`)
- **Zero-GPL 2D Full-Vector Bent & Straight Maxwell Eigenmode Solver**: Unstructured 2nd-order curl-conforming `Nedelec1/Lagrange P2` cylindrical FEM (`scikit-fem` + pure-BSD conformal Delaunay mesher) solving $n_{\mathrm{eff}}(\lambda)$, $n_g(\lambda)$, single-mode width cutoffs ($W_{\mathrm{SM}}$), trapezoidal sidewalls, and crystal anisotropy (`4H-SiC`, `X-cut/Z-cut LiNbO3`, `AlN`, `ScAlN`, `GaN`).
- **Instant Ultra-High-$Q$ (`10^4` to `10^8+`) Convergence & FDTD Ring-Down Diagnostic**: Sub-femtometer `sinh` resonance clustering solves `Q > 10^7` in `~1 s` where 3D FDTD stalls for tens of nanoseconds (`>8,000` round-trips), overlays exact finite-$M$ truncated-FDTD sinc-ringing vs infinite-roundtrip TMM, and exports single-pass Coupler-Only 3D-FDTD Cutout `.GDS` + `.lsf` (`<1 ps`, `>10,000x` faster).
- **License-Free Chip I/O Couplers (`Butt/Edge` & `2D-FDFD Surface Grating Coupler`)**: Optimizes inverse-taper edge couplers (`2D Vector FEM` + complex Poynting overlap + `1-dB/3-dB` alignment tolerance + EME taper length) and surface grating couplers (`Rytov 2nd-order Bragg/apodized synthesis` + native `2D Full-Wave Maxwell FDFD` with `UPML`, `BOX`/substrate interference, focusing `.GDS`, `127 um` fiber-array ring loopback `.GDS`, and INTERCONNECT `SPAR .dat`).
- **7 Microring Topologies & Automatic Critical-Coupling Synthesis**: Point-coupled circular (`2-port AP` / `4-port AD`), straight-section racetrack (`AP` / `AD`), concentric wrap-around pulley (`AP` / `AD` with azimuthal phase-mismatch $\Delta\beta$ integration), and 2nd-order Vernier / CROW filters.
- **Native 2D-FEM Active Tuning (`TO` / `EO` / `Si PN-PIN`) & Lumerical INTERCONNECT Export (Zero COMSOL)**: Solves 2D Fourier heat conduction FEM (`TiN`/`Pt`/`W` microheaters, `BOX` thickness -> $R_{\mathrm{th}}$, $P_\pi$, $f_{3\mathrm{dB}}$), 2D anisotropic Laplace electrostatics (`GSG`/vertical electrodes -> dielectric screening, $C_{\mathrm{elec}}$, $V_\pi L$), and 2D Silicon PN depletion / PIN injection (Soref-Bennett $\Delta n + i\Delta k$, $W_{\mathrm{dep}}(V)$, $C_j(V)$, $R_s$, modal FCA), feeding perturbed complex $\tilde{n}(x,y)$ into the 2D Maxwell eigenmode solver across `V`, `mA`, `mW`, `dT [K]`, or `E [V/um]` and exporting turnkey Ansys Lumerical INTERCONNECT compact-model `.zip` bundles (`SPAR .dat`, `OMM .txt`, `.lsf`, `lumapi`).
- **Cleanroom Lithography Dose & Photoresist Polarity Error Analysis**: Evaluates simultaneous core width ($W \pm \Delta\mathrm{CD}$) and anti-correlated coupler gap ($g \mp \eta\Delta\mathrm{CD}$) shifts under **Positive PR** (`ZEP520A`, `CSAR 62`, `PMMA`, `KrF/ArF DUV`) and **Negative PR** (`HSQ`, `ma-N 2403`, `SU-8`, lift-off) over-dose and under-dose, extracts `ER >= 15 dB` process yield windows, and exports 5-cell pre-biased compensation `.GDS` arrays.
- **24 Clean-Room Optical Materials (`400 nm` to `14 um`)**: `TiO2`, `Ta2O5`, `GaN`, `Diamond`, `Al2O3`, `Si3N4`, `SiRich_SiNx`, `AlN`, `ScAlN_10`, `ScAlN_20`, `ScAlN_30`, `4H-SiC`, `3C-SiC`, `LN_Zcut`, `LN_Xcut`, `Si`, `a-Si`, `Ge`, `CaF2`, `MgF2`, `GSST_amorphous`, `GSST_crystalline`, `SiO2`, `Air`, `Custom`.
- **Bidirectional GDSII / OASIS Bridge (`gdstk` + `shapely`)**: Upload any `.gds`/`.oas` layout to auto-detect topology and measure `R`, `W_ring`, `W_bus`, `gap`, `L_s`, and `pulley_angle` from polygons, or export foundry-ready single cells and MPW sweep arrays + KLayout `.lyp`.
- **Experimental Lab Spectrum CMT Fitter**: Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) auto-selection across Lorentzian, CW/CCW backscattering Split-Doublet (`Q_int`, `Q_ext`, `2g/2pi`), Fano, and Multi-FSR traces.
- **Token-Minimal Local Compute (`<150 tokens/call`)**: Exposes `microring mcp` (`10` stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP tools) and `microring agent <subcommand>` with persistent SSD mode caching (`outputs/.mode_cache/`).

## Quick Agent Commands
- Hardware & valid keys: `uv run microring agent status`
- Single-mode width cutoff: `uv run microring agent width-cutoff --mat Si3N4 --h 0.40 --wl 1550 --pol TE0`
- Synthesize MRR + Critical Coupling + GDS: `uv run microring agent design --top pulley_ap --mat 4H-SiC --h 0.60 --w-ring 1.10 --w-bus 0.82 --fsr 150 --gap 0.24 --cc --gds`
- Butt/Edge or 2D-FDFD Grating Coupler: `uv run microring agent io-coupler --type grating_coupler --mat Si --h 0.22 --etch 0.07 --loopback --interconnect`
- High-Q Convergence & Coupler Cutout: `uv run microring agent high-q --mat Si3N4 --r 100 --loss 0.08 --gap 0.42 --cutout`
- Positive/Negative PR Dose & CD Error: `uv run microring agent fab-tolerance --mat Si3N4 --top pulley_ap --resist positive_pr --dose-pct 15 --cc --bias-gds`
- 2D-FEM Active Tuning & INTERCONNECT Export: `uv run microring agent active-tuning --mat Si --h 0.22 --slab 0.09 --w-ring 0.48 --w-bus 0.44 --r 20 --mech si_pn_depletion --biases "0,-2,-5" --interconnect`
- Multi-point sweep + MPW GDS array: `uv run microring agent sweep --top pulley_ap --mat 4H-SiC --param pulley_angle_thru_deg --min 6 --max 24 --n 7 --array-gds`
- Extract `.gds` polygon dimensions: `uv run microring agent inspect-gds path/to/ring.gds`
- Fit measured lab spectrum CSV: `uv run microring agent fit path/to/spectrum.csv --model auto --regime under`
